### ⚠️ Requires [Sync](https://modrinth.com/mod/sync) to be installed! ⚠️

## Is Selected Stolen Power

---


[Entity Condition Types](https://origins.readthedocs.io/en/latest/types/entity_condition_types/)

Returns `true` if the entity currently has a stolen power package selected (via [Cycle Stolen Power](https://0vergrown.github.io/Sync-Documentation-Website/?file=entity_actions/cycle_stolen_power)), optionally checking whether the selection matches a specific source identifier.

Type ID: `sync:is_selected_stolen_power`

---

### Examples

```json
{
    "type": "sync:is_selected_stolen_power"
}
```
Returns `true` if the entity has any stolen power package selected.

```json
{
    "type": "sync:is_selected_stolen_power",
    "source": "my_datapack:origin_powers"
}
```
Returns `true` only if the currently selected package originally came from `my_datapack:origin_powers`.

x-intellij-html-description:
title: Is Selected Stolen Power (Entity Condition) date: 2024-01-07

Is Selected Stolen Power

Entity Condition Types

Returns true if the entity currently has a stolen power package selected (via Cycle Stolen Power), optionally checking whether the selection matches a specific source identifier.

Type ID: sync:is_selected_stolen_power

Fields

Field Type Default Description
source Identifier optional If provided, returns true only if the currently selected stolen package came from this source identifier

Notes

  • If source is omitted, the condition simply checks whether the entity has any stolen power package selected at all.
  • This is useful for gating a Use Selected Stolen Power or Transfer (give mode) call behind a UI check.
  • Returns false for entities that have never stolen any powers.

Examples

{
    "type": "sync:is_selected_stolen_power"
}

Returns true if the entity has any stolen power package selected.

{
    "type": "sync:is_selected_stolen_power",
    "source": "my_datapack:origin_powers"
}

Returns true only if the currently selected package originally came from my_datapack:origin_powers.
